significance: The principal Krishna temple of Thodupuzha town, standing on the bank of the Thodupuzhayar. The article records that a raja of Keezhmalanadu built the shrine and consecrated the image; tantric rights belong to the Aramallur Kavanattu Mana.
story: A Brahmin pilgrim resting here is said to have received a vision of Krishna, bathed in the river and worshipped him on the Chothi day of Meenam, the day still kept as the temple's origin.
